name: GAME ON
author: Sean McCormick
description: Interactive showcase skin: a living field of always-solvable image sliding puzzles behind a clean GRAM grid, with an 80%-viewport playable modal.

skin_avatar.label: Profile Avatar
skin_avatar.hint: Square image recommended. Displayed as a circle, ~77px.

options.per_carousel: Per Post (each post defines its own style)
options.per_image: Per Image (each photo has its own style)

go_treatment_mode.label: Background Treatment
go_treatment_mode.hint: Adds a full-page background behind a centred content card on every page.

go_treatment_image.label: Treatment Image
go_treatment_image.hint: Used when Treatment = Background image. Minimum 1920×1080px.

go_treatment_position.label: Image Anchor (when it overshoots)
go_treatment_position.hint: Which edge the background image hugs when it is taller than the screen.

go_treatment_overlay.label: Overlay  (left darkens · right lightens)
go_treatment_overlay.hint: Centre = none. Drag left to darken the background, right to lighten it.

go_nav_tile_gap.label: Nav → Tiles Gap
go_nav_tile_gap.hint: Vertical space between the sticky nav bar and the first row of tiles.

go_post_count_color.label: Post Count Colour
go_post_count_color.hint: Colour of the post count number and label.
